in_hebrew.name: יִשְׁבָאֵל
in_hebrew.long_meaning: The name Isbel is derived from the Hebrew language, where it is written as 'יִשְׁבָאֵל' (Yishva'el). The name is composed of two elements: 'יִשְׁ' (Yish) which means 'El (God)' and 'בָאֵל' (Ba'el) which means 'causes to laugh'. The name Isbel, therefore, can be interpreted as 'El (God) causes to laugh'.

in_greek.name: Ισβελ
in_greek.long_meaning: The name Isbel in Greek is written as 'Ισβελ' (Isbel). The Greek name Isbel is derived from the Hebrew name 'יִשְׁבָאֵל' (Yishva'el). The Greek meaning of the name Isbel is 'God is my salvation'.
